messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Readiness Syndicate: QBR Brief & Remaining Risk Items

Team —

QBR prep is underway and the execs want a concise cross-functional readout focused on readiness gaps that could materially impact the Horizon Cloud pilot go-live and the QBR narrative. I attached a short brief and pulled together the top open risks below. Please review and reply with status updates by EOD Monday (11/22). We'll lock the QBR slide pack on Tuesday morning.

Top open items (owner — action — deadline):
- Enablement: final playbook + 1 pager for sales (marissa_cole) — publish to Drive + enablement session by 11/24
- Pricing: confirm promotional uplift and contract language for pilot (marcus_lin) — sign-off by 11/23
- Docs: public quickstart + known gaps log (marissa_cole) — initial public quickstart by 11/24; gaps doc shared
- Support: runbook + routing + after-hours coverage (ben_carter) — runbook draft by 11/20; staffing plan by 11/23
- Legal/Procure: finalize PO flow with Horizon procurement (external) — procurement checklist to legal by 11/21

Current asks from me:
1) Marissa — attach the docs gap list in your reply and call out any content blockers (APIs, screenshots, or infra changes).
2) Marcus — I need explicit pricing language to include in the QBR appendix; if there's any discount banding we should disclose, please annotate.
3) Ben — confirm standby paging and escalation matrix; flag any coverage shortfalls that would require contractor support.

Logistics: 30-min readiness sync scheduled Mon 11/22 10:00-10:30 PT. If you cannot make it, drop a short status update in this thread.

Attachments: qbr-readiness-brief.pdf (high level slide brief)

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Director, GTM Programs
Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

Ava — thanks for the clear rundown. Quick status on docs and enablement:

What is ready
- Internal enablement deck (v0.9) — walkthrough recorded, needs minor edits
- API quickstart (internal) — draft live on staging docs site

Gaps/blockers
- Public quickstart: waiting on final API response samples from infra (engineering) — ETA 11/23. This is the gating item for the customer-facing quickstart.
- Screenshots: UI screen changes pushed this week; I need a stable build to capture assets (target 11/22 morning).

I'll attach a gap tracker (docs-gap-list.xlsx) that enumerates page-level gaps and owners. For the enablement session, I recommend 45 minutes: 20m demo, 20m common questions + playbook + 5m logistics.

I can have the public quickstart page ready for QA by 11/24 if engineering delivers the sample responses. If not, we should plan a narrow “developer preview” call-out in the QBR rather than a broadly-publicized quickstart.

Attachment: docs-gap-list.xlsx

Marissa Cole

Ava / team —

Support readiness summary:
- Runbook: initial draft attached (support-runbook-v1.md). Covers triage, SLAs, escalation matrix (Tier 1/2/3) and known issues for the Horizon pilot.
- Coverage: core support staff confirmed for PST business hours. We do not yet have after-hours contractor coverage for weekends — that is a risk if the customer requests 24/7 support during pilot.
- Tools: routing rules in Zendesk are configured for pilot tags; monitoring alerts will forward to the on-call channel.

Mitigations proposed:
1) Short-term contractor coverage (SupportOps Inc.) for weekend on-call (estimated $6k/week) — contact ops@supportops.com for statement of work.
2) Prioritize triage playbook items that reduce repeat escalations (metrics: time to first response, ticket reopen rate).

I can have the runbook in its final form by 11/23 if we lock the escalation contacts and confirm contractor details. Otherwise, ETA slides to QBR: include runbook snapshot + callout on coverage gap and the mitigation cost.

Attachment: support-runbook-v1.md

Ben Carter
Head of Support Operations

Thanks, all. Quick leadership decisions to remove ambiguity for the QBR narrative:

1) Pricing: Marcus, please provide the final pilot pricing language and appendix paragraph by COB Monday 11/23. If there are any approvals required from finance, escalate to me immediately. We will not delay the slide lock for incremental discounts beyond what was budgeted in DEAL-2026-1120-HZC.

2) Docs/Enablement: Marissa — proceed with a staged public quickstart: 1) publish a developer-preview quickstart on 11/24 with a clear “preview” watermark, 2) full public quickstart when API samples arrive. We will call the preview out in the QBR instead of flagging a missing quickstart.

3) Support: Ben — pursue the contractor option if the customer requests weekend coverage. Capture the mitigation cost as an appendix item in the QBR slides. Please confirm the contractor SOW by 11/23.

Ava — thank you for coordinating. I'll own the QBR narrative on the readiness slide and will include a short mitigation table that lists impact, owner, and cost where applicable.

Laura Bennett
